description_en: Segments and structures exam questions. You can input an exam paper or a full-page question image, and the algorithm returns the position information and structured data (question stem, options, answers, etc.) for each question
description_zh: 切题及题目结构化接口，客户输入试卷或整页题目图片，算法返回每个题目的位置信息以及结构化（题干、选项、答案等）信息
kebab_example: aliyun edututor cut-questions --workspace-id llm-1ijrzuv3v0ivvls7 --image https://oss.xxx.com/xx.png --parameters struct=true extract_images=true --region cn-hangzhou
